note: Hand-written (phase 5 design 4.4; D138). What a preset body's schema cannot hold: validatePreset in packages/presets/src/validate.ts, run on a body its schema accepted (preset-bodies.json), against the team's other presets and its note types. The reader is packages/presets/test/validate.test.ts; the phone does not read this file. Each case calls validatePreset({kind, body, refs, definitions, id}) and must give `expected`, compared as a set: each problem {path, code}, `path` the body path at fault written as an issue path is (parts joined by dots, '' for the body itself). `refs` is the team's presets by id (the file's, unless a case gives its own): each {kind, state, behaviour}, behaviour being a category's own or, for an item, its category's; a preset of another kind has none. A category or an item given without one of supply, medication and lab is unknown_reference, as refs read from the heads alone would be: the rules that read it are never passed for want of it. `definitions` is the current definition of each of the team's active note types (the file's): one written out, or {released: N}, version N of that key in packages/forms/generated/presets.json. `id` is the preset's own id, null for one not yet made. The codes: unknown_reference (an id names no preset of the team: another team's is not among refs), wrong_kind (an id names a preset of another kind: categoryId an order_category, every itemId an item), reference_archived (an id names an archived preset; it is still read, so the rules below still apply to what it says), result_mismatch (an item has a result exactly when its category's behaviour is lab), medical_mismatch (an item in a medication or lab category is Medical; in a supply category the switch is free), bundle_not_medical (a bundle holding an item whose category is a medication category is Medical, PRD main 447; a Labs item does not make it so), primary_sensitive (a primary flag is never sensitive), unknown_note_type (a map names a note type key the team does not offer), unknown_path (a map's path names, through fieldAt with the entry part a repeating section adds, no field's or grid cell's own answer: nothing, an entry's own answer, an Other text, a side, a region's or a diagnosis's part, or a path written with an entry part), path_kind (it names a field or cell of a kind no map fires on: only choice, number and flag, and with answered also text, date and duration, are mapped; a group, a grid as a whole, a region, a diagnosis, a time, a photo, an action, guidance, or a field with sides, whose own path stores nothing), when_invalid (the when does not fit the field: includes names a code a choice field holds; equals names a code a choice field holds, a number checkAnswer takes at that path, or true for a tick; answered fits every mapped kind), from_path (a fromPath names no number that has one answer where the map fires: a map in a repeating section reads a number of its own section, so of the same entry; a map on a grid's cell reads a number in the same row of that grid; any other map, a map on every note included, reads a number outside every repeating section), sensitive_path (what the map fires on lies where visibleAnswers may take it out from a reader who may read the note: mayBeHidden(definition, path, when) for the path, mayBeHidden(definition, fromPath) for each fromPath, and for a note type that is sensitive, mayBeHidden(definition) at noteTypeKey, refused as a whole with nothing else of its path or quantities checked), settings_taken (a settings preset made when the team holds one, archived or not; editing the one it holds is not refused). For a map, the path is checked in this order, the first that fails reported: unknown_path, path_kind, when_invalid, sensitive_path; each fromPath: from_path, then sensitive_path; a note type the team does not offer, or a sensitive one, stops the path's and the quantities' checks. Every id is checked whatever else fails: unknown_reference, else wrong_kind, else reference_archived. An item whose category is unknown or of another kind has nothing read from it. The definitions demo_supplies and demo_marked are made up and pass forms' validate(); every id is made up.
